title: bot.ability.cognition.step.timed_out
description:
A step of the bot's cognition took longer than its step timeout, so the turn it was taking failed.

The bot perceives this as a turn of its own: which step it was in, how long that step was allowed, and which turn failed for which stimulus. Only the step was stopped; nothing was rebooted and every ability kept its state.

message.description: Human-readable failure message for the ability operation.
message.title: Message

stage.description: The stage of cognition that outlasted its timeout: reflex (a behavior running, or the decision model choosing on what no behavior handled), intuition (the fast words) or reasoning (the deliberate thinking).
stage.title: Stage

timeout_seconds.description: How long the step was allowed, in seconds, before the turn failed.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

turn.description: The body's processing turn that failed, counted from 1; the original's turn_id [floppy field].

stimulus.description: Name of the stimulus the failed turn was taken up for, when it has one.
stimulus.title: Stimulus

examples.message: Cognition's reasoning step took longer than 120 seconds, so the turn failed.
